svg.title: ElectroCookie Mini resistor-interface placement: top view
svg.text: 38.1 x 50.8mm; no board cuts. Verify strip continuity on your actual board first.
Teal: controller ground / J1. Orange: Sony-side wiring / J2.
Green: input resistors. Gray rows show factory-connected groups of five pads.
Use insulated jumpers; crossings are not connections. Some resistors stand upright.
Pin 1 dot at upper left. Each package spans the center gap.
Use corner mounts; leave central M3 holes unused near relays.
Dry-fit actual lead lengths / insulation / enclosure before soldering.
